revisions.concept: Big close-up: Eli's head and shoulders fill the whole right half of the frame, his face amazed with an open mouth, holding a small lit clay oil lamp up beside his face inside a dark rock tunnel; a thin stream of bright blue water runs along the bare floor. Nothing else at all. Simple dark background, clear empty top quarter, no lettering.
